rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: pydeseq2 Wald with design ~condition, control as explicit reference and lesional-vs-control contrast, median-of-ratios inside the model with no pre-normalization, BH at 0.05 with apeglm-style shrinkage and lfcThreshold inside the test if an effect size is wanted. QC covers library sizes, detected genes, blind VST, PCA on 500 genes, distance heatmap, and a stated keep-by-default policy for sample_01 with a sensitivity run if dropped. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full list ranked by the Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1 named, 15-500 window, seed recorded, and unmapped-gene share reported. The low-count filter (>=10 in >=6 samples) is justified by the smallest group size but is somewhat more than minimal; the report step names methods, versions, design, thresholds, counts, and the specific caveats (shallow library, missing length offset, modest n).
